I don't usually leave reviews, but it's only right to share my experience, which was unfortunately negative.
My cat has been their patient since birth. "Dr." Lamura's empathy has always been zero, never a word or exchange of opinions regarding the animal, but, oh well, that's irrelevant. What I'm pointing out is that she's always been rude to me and even to my mother, both via email and in person. Even worse: in March 2025, she gave me FIV/FELV tests for another cat, always responding rudely via email. When my beloved 5-year-old cat died—and when I requested a death certificate—she didn't even ask me a question, nor offer a word of comfort. She simply said, "It's €30." I'd say even animals don't behave like that, but I'd be paying her a compliment; animals are wonderful beings.
Needless to say, my veterinary experience with them ended there. I'll take my new friend elsewhere, and I recommend staying away from this establishment.
Never again.
I've been taking my Cocker Spaniel to this clinic for a while now, and I've always been satisfied. The staff is friendly and always available.
Both the doctor and the woman are excellent. I took both my dog ​​and cat to them and they were excellent in both cases.

They welcomed us with kindness and professionalism. The doctor patiently examined our two cats (a British and Scottish) and administered their vaccinations. She then suggested a remedy for a problem with one of them. We'll try it now. Thank you, great place and well-kept!

Terrible place!! Stay away from incompetent and negligent people... a FILV communicated telegonically via the secretary for FIB... but my cat is perfectly healthy... a spay paid 220 euros... a real scam!! My cat was pumped full of antibiotics post-surgery without even the slightest medical assistance in understanding the exact amount to administer, but dismissed with a huff: read the instructions for the animal's weight and quantity! The doctor is terrible! My cat complained of diarrhea all summer, a phenomenon clearly linked to the etiology of the surgery and its disastrous side effects! Painkillers would have been enough, as in any serious veterinary practice! She should be struck off! Absolutely not recommended!!!

I discovered the clinic, and Dr. La Mura in particular, in 2019 when my little 2-year-old Leo was constantly sick and requiring extensive treatment month after month. A friend recommended her to me, who, after six years, had also had a permanent recovery from her four-legged friend's severe and extensive dermatitis, thanks to the doctor's exceptional expertise.
When I took my Leo for a visit, a single exam was enough to enlighten the doctor and a single treatment was enough to truly give my puppy a new lease on life!
But beyond her expertise, the doctor has a perfect empathy for furry friends, but also for us mothers/owners, so she calms any anxiety and worry!
I wholeheartedly recommend the clinic because it's a clean, organized environment, and fully equipped to meet every need.
After many experiences I finally found the mix I was looking for for my furry children: competence and lovingness, Dr. Mura is top ♥️
